reason: The code implements proper XSS mitigation: (1) Input comes from HTTP header names which have restricted character sets per HTTP spec, limiting XSS payload possibilities; (2) ESAPI's encodeForHTML() is called on str before HTML rendering (line 99), properly escaping special characters; (3) Cookie is configured with Secure=true and HttpOnly=true providing additional protection.
